slides.title: Image Processing
slides.content:
# OpenCV 👁️

Computer vision!

```python
import cv2

# Read image
img = cv2.imread('image.jpg')

# Convert color
gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

# Resize
resized = cv2.resize(img, (300, 300))

# Save
cv2.imwrite('output.jpg', gray)
```

slides.title: Operations
slides.content:
# Image Operations 🔧

```python
# Blur
blurred = cv2.GaussianBlur(img, (5, 5), 0)

# Edge detection
edges = cv2.Canny(img, 100, 200)

# Draw shapes
cv2.rectangle(img, (10, 10), (100, 100), (0, 255, 0), 2)
cv2.circle(img, (50, 50), 30, (255, 0, 0), -1)

# Display
cv2.imshow('Image', img)
cv2.waitKey(0)
```
